Class STS

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.EquinixClient
com.eqixiac.equinix.STS
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public final class STS extends EquinixClient
The primary entry point for accessing the Equinix Security Token Service (STS) API (STS v1).

The STS exchanges OpenID Connect (OIDC) ID tokens — issued by trusted OIDC providers — for Equinix access tokens (RFC 8693 token exchange), and manages the trust relationships and discovery metadata that underpin that exchange:

  • tokens() — the OAuth 2.0 token exchange (POST /v1/token) and the granted-access-policy listing (POST /v1/accessPoliciesGranted).
  • oidcProviders() — registration and lifecycle (create / page / patch / delete / suspend / resume) of trusted OIDC providers within a root project.
  • discovery() — the unauthenticated discovery endpoints: the JSON Web Key Set (GET /jwks) and the OpenID Connect discovery document (GET /.well-known/openid-configuration).

Each accessor uses lazy initialization — the internal client is created on first access and reused for subsequent calls.

Service host

The STS v1 OpenAPI specification declares its own service host (https://sts.eqix.equinix.com), with the discovery endpoints (/jwks and /.well-known/openid-configuration) served at the host root and token exchange under /v1/token. This SDK, however, routes every domain — STS included — through the unified Equinix API gateway (https://api.equinix.com) configured on the shared EquinixClient, which fronts the per-service hosts and exposes the same paths (the bearerAuth security scheme is likewise defined against the gateway). The relative request URIs in apiParams_STS.json are therefore resolved against that single gateway host rather than the spec's per-service sts.eqix.equinix.com server. This is the intended SDK-wide design; no per-domain host override is provided.

Quick Start

BasicEquinixCredentials credentials = new BasicEquinixCredentials("clientId", "clientSecret");
STS sts = new STS(credentials);

StsToken token = sts.tokens().generate(new TokenRequest()
    .grantType("urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange")
    .subjectToken(idToken)
    .subjectTokenType("urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token")
    .scope("accesspolicy:abc-123:idp:example-policy"));
